_about: Combat Lab ART values (Claude, 2026-11-04), NOT rules. Tons per cubic metre at 6 m a level, used by INTEGRATION__shell.py to turn a mass into a drawn volume (volume = mass / density) for the skeleton-and-shell model. They are tuned so that the whole of a 'Mech comes to about 0.8 cubic metres a ton (the old 0.0037 levels^3 per ton) and so that a dense 1-slot item is short and thick while a light many-slot item is long and slim. Daniel (2026-11-04): different equipment may have different densities; volume is only a sanity check. Change a number here and the models change; nothing in a battle reads this file.
slot_length_why: One critical slot is 0.4 m of an item's length along its mount: a 12-slot arm is 4.8 m, near a 100-ton 'Mech's real arm; a 10-slot AC/20 is a 4 m gun.
min_plate_why: No shell plate is drawn thinner than 5 cm at scale (the test fails below it).

laser.why: lens stack, capacitor and cooling block: compact and heavy for its size

ppc.why: accelerator coils around a short barrel: dense

ac.why: a steel barrel and breech: close to solid metal

lbx.why: same as the autocannon: steel barrel, breech and choke

uac.why: twin steel barrels and a feed: same as the autocannon

rotary.why: barrel cluster and motor drum: same as the autocannon

gauss.why: long coils with air gaps between them: lighter than a cannon, so longer and slimmer

flamer.why: a fuel tank and a nozzle

missile.why: a bundle of 25 kg missiles in tubes: mostly air between the rounds

ammo.why: a bin of packed shells or missiles

heatsink_double.why: finer fins and a coolant loop: a little denser than a single

ecm.why: electronics in a dome or dish

probe.why: electronics in a dome or dish

c3.why: electronics in a dome or dish

ams.why: a small rapid-fire gun and its ammo feed

misc.why: equipment with no face: MASC, TSM, targeting computer, other electronics

structure_slot.why: an endo-steel or ferro-fibrous filler slot: its mass is already in structure or armor, so it adds none (tons 0)

engine.why: reactor, shielding and a coolant plant

structure.why: frame and myomer bundles: a limb or torso is mostly muscle with air around it

armor.why: layered plate with air gaps between the layers

fallback_tons._note: Used only when mechsim/equipment.json has no tonnage for an item and MegaMek's value was not looked up: the item is counted in INTEGRATION__shell.FALLBACKS so a report can list it. Heat sinks 1 t, ammo 1 t per slot, a jump jet by the 'Mech's mass, anything else 0.5 t a slot.

engine_tons._note: Standard fusion engine mass by rating (Claude's recall of the construction table, art only; log-interpolated between rows). XL x0.5, Light x0.75, Compact x1.5.
